threats.title: Sensitive records can be exposed
countermeasures: Encrypt data at rest with managed keys or KMS.
Restrict network access and apply least privilege database roles.
Mask or tokenize sensitive attributes where possible.

threats.title: Public flow without explicit WAF or edge filtering
threats.evidence: The architecture contains an external flow, but no WAF component was detected.
countermeasures: Place a WAF or equivalent edge control before public APIs.
Add rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection at the edge.

threats.title: Database present without explicit backup component
threats.evidence: A database was detected, but no backup/recovery component was detected.
countermeasures: Configure automated backups, retention policy, and restore testing.
Define RTO/RPO and alert on backup job failures.

absenceEvidence: A database is present and no component with canonical type 'backup' was present.

threats.title: Trust-boundary flow has an unverified protocol
threats.evidence: A flow crosses a trust boundary, but its protocol and protection could not be confirmed from the diagram.
countermeasures: Confirm the protocol, authentication method, and encryption properties during human review.
Require TLS, certificate validation, and integrity protection for boundary-crossing traffic.

threats.title: Compromised workload can gain broader permissions
countermeasures: Use least privilege IAM roles and avoid long-lived credentials.
Harden runtime, patch dependencies, and isolate workloads by trust level.

threats.title: Application code or configuration can be changed
countermeasures: Use signed deployments, immutable artifacts, and CI/CD approvals.
Separate deploy permissions from runtime permissions.

threats.title: API clients can forge identity or tokens
threats.evidence: Component: Api Gateway. Rule source: component-rule:generic.
countermeasures: Validate JWT issuer, audience, expiration, and signature.
Use OAuth2/OIDC and mTLS for service-to-service integrations.
Apply least privilege scopes per endpoint.

threats.title: Request payload can be modified before reaching backend
threats.evidence: Component: Api Gateway. Rule source: component-rule:generic.
countermeasures: Validate schemas at the gateway and backend.
Reject unexpected fields and enforce content-type restrictions.

threats.title: API endpoint can be overloaded
threats.evidence: Component: Api Gateway. Rule source: component-rule:generic.
countermeasures: Enable throttling, quotas, circuit breakers, and request size limits.
Add alerts for latency spikes and unusual request volume.

threats.title: Object storage can expose private files
countermeasures: Block public access by default and review bucket/container policies.
Encrypt objects and classify sensitive data.

threats.title: Missing or mutable logs reduce forensic capability
countermeasures: Centralize logs and protect them with immutable retention.
Log authentication, authorization, data access, and administrative actions.

threats.title: Data can be changed without integrity controls
countermeasures: Use transactions, constraints, audit trails, and change history for sensitive tables.
Monitor abnormal write volume and privileged updates.

threats.title: Database can be exhausted by expensive queries
countermeasures: Apply query timeouts, connection pooling, resource limits, and read replicas.
Alert on CPU, locks, storage, and connection saturation.

threats.title: Public entry point can be abused by high traffic
countermeasures: Use rate limiting, WAF rules, bot protection, and autoscaling.
Define abuse thresholds and monitoring alerts for public endpoints.

threats.title: Traffic can be altered if transport is weak
countermeasures: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ end to end.
Reject insecure protocols and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

threats.title: Backend actions may not be attributable
countermeasures: Propagate request correlation ids across services.
Log actor, service identity, request id, and authorization decision.

threats.title: API responses can expose sensitive data
threats.evidence: Component: Api Gateway. Rule source: component-rule:generic.
countermeasures: Filter sensitive fields before response serialization.
Use consistent error handling that does not leak stack traces or secrets.

threats.title: Stored artifacts can be modified
countermeasures: Enable object versioning and integrity checks.
Use write-once retention for critical evidence or backups.

threats.title: Logs can contain secrets or personal data
countermeasures: Redact tokens, passwords, and sensitive payload fields.
Restrict log access and audit log queries.

threats.title: Cached content can expose sensitive responses
countermeasures: Disable caching for authenticated or sensitive endpoints.
Validate cache-control headers and purge workflows.

threats.title: Origin or cache configuration can be abused
countermeasures: Restrict origin access to the CDN.
Use signed URLs or signed cookies for protected content.

threats.title: User identity can be impersonated
countermeasures: Require strong authentication with MFA for privileged flows.
Use short-lived sessions and secure cookie attributes.
Bind sensitive actions to re-authentication.

threats.title: User actions may not be traceable
countermeasures: Log security-relevant actions with user id, source, timestamp, and request correlation id.
Protect audit logs against deletion or tampering.
